Verses.1: /tTherefore, if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any communion with the Spirit, if any tenderness and compassion,
Verses.2: then make my joy complete. Be of the same mind, sharing the same love, united in spirit, and being of one purpose.
Verses.3: Do nothing out of selfishness or conceit. Instead, in humility, consider others as more important than yourselves.
Verses.4: Let each of you look not only to your own interests, but also the interests of others.
Verses.5: Hold this attitude among one another, which is also in Christ Jesus:
Verses.6: Who, though He was in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped.
Verses.7: He instead emptied Himself by taking the form of a servant and being born in human likeness.
Verses.8: Being found in human form, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to death, even death on a cross.
Verses.9: For this reason, God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above every name.
Verses.10: So that at the name of Jesus every knee will bow, in heaven, on the earth, and under the earth.
Verses.11: And every tongue will confess that "Jesus Christ is Lord," to the glory of God the Father.

Changes: 2025-02-05 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 1-11.
